decision_summary: Approve QIF v0.6.23 Inventory CLI for release.
rationale: Visionary: inventory gives agents a structural map before choosing QIF actions. Builder: implementation reuses collectEntities, package parsing, outbound reference detection, and cache metadata without external dependencies. Guardian: inventory remains structural visibility only and does not claim semantic quality truth, completeness, or evidence sufficiency.
recommendation: Release v0.6.23 after final structural checks, residue scan, commit, tag, and GitHub Release.
